notes: Drag and drop on the computer: drop images, ZIP/CBZ files or whole folders onto an open gallery or folder to add them right there. Images become pages; ZIP files and folders become folders inside, keeping their structure.
You can still choose “Make a new gallery instead”. Dropping on the library makes new galleries as before, and now whole folders work too (one gallery per folder).
While dragging, the window shows where the files will go.
